name: Ombre
summary: Classic 17th century 3-player bidding trick-taking game where one player, Ombre, bids trumps and plays alone against two defenders.
rules_text: Play with 40 cards (strip 8s,9s,10s). 3 players, 9 cards each, 13 card talon. Spades are always highest trump hierarchy: Ace of spades (spadille), black 2 or red 7 (manille), Ace of clubs (basto). In red trump, Ace of red suit is 4th trump. Dealer antes 5. Bid clockwise: Entrada (choose trump then exchange), Vuelta (turn top talon for trump then exchange), Solo (choose trump, no exchange) from low to high. Pass cannot re-enter but can raise to equal. Highest bidder is Ombre and chooses trumps. Ombre discards any number and draws same from talon, then defenders in agreed order may each draw up to 8 from remaining talon. Play 9 tricks, eldest leads first, must follow suit if able, highest trump or highest of led suit wins. Ombre needs more tricks than each opponent alone (5+ wins, 4 wins if defenders split 3-2). If successful wins pool, if opponent wins most Ombre pays that opponent, if tie Ombre pays pool. Bonuses for vole (all tricks).
rating_reason: Classic 3-player trick-taking with bidding, high strategy.
